article.title: Paying workers to vaccinate
article.excerpt: Trader Joe’s is the latest business to offer an incentive for workers getting the COVID-19 vaccine. The Monrovia, California-based grocery chain said Thursday it will give employees two hours of pay per dose for getting the vaccine and will also shift around schedules to make sure employees have time to get vaccinated.
